notes: AgroGeneration S.A. (Euronext Growth Paris, ticker ALAGR). Identified via seed-comps and Boursorama lookup — NOT Agripower or Vilmorin. AgroGeneration operates ~28,500 ha (~70.4k acres) of Ukrainian farmland under long-term lease, growing wheat, sunflower, corn, and soy in Kharkiv region. French semi-annual reporter (H1 June + FY December). War-impacted since 2022 with Kharkiv operations near front lines; multiple write-downs. Tiny float (~100M shares); equity recapitalized 2023. Per-share NAV €0.111 per seed-comps. Coverage limited — only headline P&L disclosed in interim communiqués.

periods.notes: H1 22: war disruption begins; Kharkiv-based operations directly impacted
FY22: war write-downs; equipment losses in Kharkiv region
FY23: partial recovery; equity recapitalisation completed
FY24 per seed-comps: revenue €22.6M, EBITDA €5.7M, net debt €9.19M, NAV/share €0.111. Filing 2025-06-30. Property book minimal (€3M) reflects Ukrainian farmland is leased not owned.
